spec.title: Kamiwaza · Extensions & Platform Operator
spec.description: Extensions, sandbox pools, and the controller that reconciles the platform.

spec.description: Extensions whose Ready condition is True

spec.title: Extensions not ready

spec.title: Restarts (1h)
spec.description: Container restarts in extension pods over the last hour

spec.expr: round(sum(increase(kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total{namespace="$namespace"}[1h]) * on (namespace, pod) group_left () max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_labels{namespace="$namespace", label_kamiwaza_ai_extension!=""}))) or vector(0)

spec.title: Extension conditions
spec.description: Every condition the operator reports on each Extension

spec.expr: sum by (label_kamiwaza_ai_extension) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{namespace="$namespace", container!=""}[$__rate_interval]) * on (namespace, pod) group_left (label_kamiwaza_ai_extension) max by (namespace, pod, label_kamiwaza_ai_extension) (kube_pod_labels{namespace="$namespace", label_kamiwaza_ai_extension!=""}))

sum by (label_kamiwaza_ai_extension) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{namespace="$namespace", container!=""} * on (namespace, pod) group_left (label_kamiwaza_ai_extension) max by (namespace, pod, label_kamiwaza_ai_extension) (kube_pod_labels{namespace="$namespace", label_kamiwaza_ai_extension!=""}))
